questions.question:
Identify the correct form of the sentence with inversion required for emphasis on the adverbial phrase.

Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped do they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped they began to clean the garden.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location of the meeting?
options: It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was in the conference room where we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was in the conference room when we decided to postpone the meeting.
It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.
questions.answer: It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the sentence with a third conditional structure.

If they had known about the deadline, they would have completed the project earlier.
options: If they had known about the deadline, they would have completed the project earlier.
If they had known about the deadline, they would complete the project earlier.
If they had known about the deadline, they would have completed the project earlier.
If they had known about the deadline, they will complete the project earlier.
questions.answer: If they had known about the deadline, they would have completed the project earlier.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical wish?
options: I suggest that he takes a break.
I suggest that he take a break.
I suggest that he takes a break.
I suggest that he is taking a break.
questions.answer: I suggest that he take a break.

questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with ellipsis, maintaining grammatical coherence.

She enjoys painting, and her brother ______.
options: enjoys too.
does too.
enjoys as well.
does as well.
